source_trace.replay_difference: Earlier output-only replay had the exact final camera but native command basis still followed the vehicle. The optional native-observer mode supplies the recorded numeric command before 82214BC0 and stops overwriting its result.
source_trace.remaining_native_difference: Run 17 matches all 1759 attributed draw cameras exactly and its numeric command matches the human snapshot. Observer result words +0x10 through +0x24 differ: 82214BC0 reads triples at user+496 and user+536, negating the first, to produce these fields. These preceding motion inputs are not yet replayed; do not claim all native observer state matches.
source_trace.human_blob_layout: The original observer blob starts 188 bytes before the actual TLS+0x2cc allocation. Both tools resolve the pointer against the saved blob before reading fields.

limitations: Numeric probes are not human visual acceptance. Brightness changes can be authored animation, rain, shadows or other content.
A black flash has not been attributed to a draw, texture, shader or presentation failure.
The saved pose is not a complete native savestate. The human snapshot was captured after the flicker recording.
One-guest-frame flashes can span multiple 60 Hz paints. Isolated-pulse counts alone are insufficient; adjacent falls and dark-pixel counts are also retained.
Desktop composition after DXGI Present is not measured. Diagnostic overhead can affect timing.
next_step: Trace native observer inputs before interpolation (82214930 and subsequent update stages). Preserve the saved view while resolving the measured motion-input discrepancy, then target any actual darkening event. Do not infer a rendering fix from negative probe runs.
